05 / BEFORE YOUR APPOINTMENT

Booking policy.

RESERVATION DOWN PAYMENT₱500Deducted from your total service fee

Thank you for choosing Strokes by Paul Garcia. Please review the following policies before securing your appointment.

01Reservation & down payment

A ₱500 down payment is required to reserve your appointment. Your booking is confirmed only once the down payment has been received. The down payment will be deducted from your total service fee.

02Cancellation & rescheduling

Down payments are non-refundable if you cancel. They may be transferred to a new date when rescheduling, subject to availability. Please inform us in advance. Repeated rescheduling may not be accommodated.

03Payment policy

The remaining balance must be settled on or before your appointment date. Please ensure that payments are completed promptly.

04Punctuality

Please arrive on time and let us know in advance if you expect any delays. Late arrivals may affect your preparation time and other scheduled appointments.

05Home service policy

Home service in Legazpi City and Daraga has an additional ₱500 transportation fee. Outside these areas, transportation fees vary by location. Please provide your complete address so we can quote the transportation charge.

06Additional requests

Please share any preferred hairstyles, makeup inspirations, or special requests ahead of time. Add-on services must be requested in advance to ensure availability.

Your appointment is exclusively reserved once your ₱500 down payment has been received. By confirming your booking, you acknowledge and agree to these terms and conditions.
